result: For oblique-plane, sphere, saddle-like and torus-like scalar lattices, blockwise skimage Lewiner marching cubes with canonical global-lattice edge welding produced the same canonical edge-key vertex set and face set as one-block dense Lewiner marching cubes across all preregistered block layouts. Exact-zero lattice corners fail closed.
semantic_consequence: The current Lewiner MC contourer can be retained while independently changing empty-space discovery/planning. Contour topology does not need to change merely because certified empty regions are pruned.
claim_boundary: This is sampled-lattice equivalence only. Continuous hidden-surface safety remains a planner/proof obligation, and source fidelity remains a VF11/Stage13 obligation.
